title: Add bounded-confidence replay CI hook and progressive quarantine
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Adds a bounded-confidence replay CI hook that adaptively replays failing prompt cohorts and a progressive quarantine policy. Non-breaking; feature-flagged. Includes metrics and dashboards.
description: Motivation: intermittent prompt-set regressions commonly triggered by sampling noise result in noisy CI failures and unnecessary quarantines. This change introduces a bounded-confidence replay CI hook that adaptively replays failing cohorts until a statistically sound confidence interval for the failure rate is obtained (Wilson score interval) or until a configured cap is reached. The hook also integrates a progressive-quarantine policy that transitions prompt cohorts through soft->hard quarantine states based on posterior confidence rather than raw failure counts. Design: ci/hooks/bounded_confidence_replay.py implements the replay loop, statistics and retry backoff; ci/policies/progressive_quarantine.yaml contains policy knobs (min_samples, max_replays, target_ci_width, soft_threshold, hard_threshold, decay). We expose a CLI toggle (--ci-bounded-replay) and a feature flag in CI config so rollout can be staged. Observability: replay-run provenance tags, counters for replays, per-cohort confidence width time-series, and a minimal Grafana dashboard are included. Testing: unit tests for statistical logic, integration test that simulates flaky prompts with seeded variability, and a GH Actions smoke matrix entry. Rollout plan: default disabled on main, enabled for eval-infra and canary repos for two weeks, then enabled org-wide if no regression signals. Checklist: [x] implementation + unit tests [x] integration smoke [x] metrics + dashboard [x] docs + runbook [x] Linear links added (ENG-2042).
